text: あやしく　みえる　メガネ。

patterns.name: 〜く見える
patterns.explanation: A describing word with its い changed to く before みえる says how something looks. あやしく　みえる = 'looks suspicious'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: あやしく　みえる　メガネ
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes that thing. あやしく　みえる　メガネ = 'glasses that look suspicious'.
